subject: Badge data ownership & retention for Summit West (scanner integration)
messages:

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@bluewave.com>

Subject: Badge CSV and retention window for Summit West

Hi Ben + Marissa,

Quick question as we finalize the on-site capture plan for Summit West (Mar 4-6): BlueWave's scanners will export a nightly CSV with badge IDs, first/last name, company, and email. Acme (our partner) wants to confirm two things before we sign off:

- Does Redwood need the raw email address to create a HubSpot contact, or are you able to accept a hashed/email-hash column?
- What retention window does Redwood require on scanned records to deliver post-event routing to SF/HubSpot and matchback?

We need to provide this to BlueWave and include it in the MOU by EOD Friday. Attaching the scanner spec they sent.

Thanks,
Jenna
Jenna Lopez | Events Lead, Acme Corp
attachments: BlueWave_scanner_spec_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Jenna Lopez <jenna.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:08:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Badge CSV and retention window for Summit West

Hi Jenna — thanks for the heads up and the spec. Short answers up top: we prefer a hashed email column for ingestion and a 90-day retention window for raw badge exports on S3, with contact creation happening inside HubSpot immediately after ingestion.

Details / rationale:
- Hashed email: we can accept SHA256 email hash (lowercased + trimmed) as a primary key for dedupe/matchback; if Acme needs to provide unhashed emails to match with their CRM they can, but Redwood will not persist plaintext emails past ingestion unless explicitly authorized in the DPA.
- Retention window: we keep the raw nightly CSVs in a customer-scoped S3 bucket for up to 90 days to support replay/ingestion troubleshooting and data reconciliation. Processed records that make it into HubSpot follow the customer's CRM retention/consent controls.

Marissa — can you confirm HubSpot field map and whether we need any additional columns (utm, device_id) from BlueWave? Grace / Rishi — flagging for privacy/DPA scope review.

Ben Carter | Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0192
attachments: consent_text_redwood_20260218.docx (draft consent language)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: ben_carter@redwood.ai, Jenna Lopez <jenna.lopez@acme.com>
Cc: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 08:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Badge CSV and retention window for Summit West

Thanks Ben. Jenna — copying the HubSpot ingestion notes so BlueWave can map fields. Key items from ops: 

- Required columns: badge_id, first_name, last_name, company, email_hash (SHA256), scan_timestamp
- Optional but helpful: utm_source, campaign_id, device_id
- File format: nightly CSV, UTF-8, comma-delimited, headers on first row
- Ingestion cadence: we can consume nightly from S3 or accept a pushed file to our secure ingest endpoint (preferred is S3 with presigned link).

I attached our current HubSpot field map (v3) and a short integration matrix. If BlueWave cannot supply email_hash we can do hashing at ingest if they provide plaintext under a limited retention clause — prefer they hash on their side.

Open question: do we need an explicit opt-in checkbox on the badge tap to meet Acme's marketing rules? If so we should lock the exact consent copy into the MOU.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Field Ops, Redwood Inference
attachments: hubspot_field_map_v3.xlsx (xlsx), badge_scanner_integration_matrix.csv (csv)
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai

Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 11:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Badge CSV and retention window for Summit West

Hi all — quick privacy note: 90 days for raw CSVs is acceptable from our side if the DPA explicitly restricts downstream use and requires deletion after the window. A couple of suggested edits to the consent language (Ben's attached draft):

- Make explicit that hashed emails are used for matchback and that plaintext emails are not stored beyond the ingestion troubleshooting window (90 days) unless customer explicitly authorizes.
- Add a one-line opt-in copy on the badge tap: "I agree to be contacted by Acme Corp and event sponsors about related products and services." with a link to the privacy policy.

Rishi — can you confirm whether we need a short audit log of ingestion events retained beyond 90 days for compliance? If yes, we should call that out separately in the MOU (event-level metadata only, no PII).

Grace O'Connor | Customer Success, Redwood Inference
From: Jenna Lopez <jenna.lopez@acme.com>

Cc: Samir Patel <samir@bluewave.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai

Thanks everyone — that's helpful. Two follow-ups from Acme/BlueWave: 

1) BlueWave prefers to push plaintext nightly CSVs to an SFTP endpoint (they do hashing on their side by default but can toggle). Are you able to support SFTP ingestion, or do you require presigned S3?
2) Legal wants a DPA addendum before we accept plaintext emails into your pipeline. Can you send a short DPA (or DocuSign request) scoped to this event?

We aim to finalize the MOU and the data-flow appendix by next Wednesday (Feb 18).

Thanks — Jenna
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi Jenna / Samir — final checklist and next steps before we lock the MOU: 

- Ingestion endpoint: we can accept SFTP for this event (temporary SFTP bucket we create). BlueWave should send a sample nightly CSV by Mon 2/23 so ops can validate field mapping.
- Hashing: prefer email_hash from BlueWave. If they send plaintext, we will hash on ingest but require explicit DPA consent.
- Retention: Redwood will retain raw CSVs for 90 days (customer-scoped S3 or SFTP store) and processed/ingested records in HubSpot per Acme policy. Audit logs (ingestion timestamps + file checksums) will be retained for 1 year and contain no PII.
- Consent: attached is the updated consent copy (consent_text_redwood_20260218.docx). Please confirm final copy by Tue 2/24 so we can embed it in the MOU.
- DPA: sending a DocuSign request now (link below). Legal will scope the DPA to event-only processing and delete authority after 90 days.

Action owners: BlueWave (send sample CSV) / Acme legal (review DPA) / Marissa (validate mapping & setup ingest) / Grace/Rishi (confirm audit log language).

Ben Carter | Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
